# `languages/nix:T156`: stdenv runs `pre<Phase>` / `post<Phase>` hooks
# through `runHook`, under a phase's `set -eu -o pipefail`. A NixOS
# service's `postStop` goes through the same job script as `preStart`.
# Being a site is not being flagged: the one-command `postInstall` stays
# inline (`languages/shell:V3`), the three-command `preCheck` does not.
demo.preCheck | '' | bash errexit nounset pipefail | - | "\n      export HOME=$TMPDIR\n      mkdir -p \"$HOME/.cache\"\n      patchShebangs tests\n    "
demo.postInstall | " | bash errexit nounset pipefail | - | "installManPage demo.1"
systemd.services.demo.postStop | '' | bash errexit | - | "\n    rm -f /run/demo.pid\n  "
